name.description: User's display name shown to other IP Messenger clients.

icon.description: Filename of the user's icon. Can be a relative path to the icons directory or an absolute path.

port.description: UDP port number used for IP Messenger communication.

auto_detect.description: Enable automatic detection of other IP Messenger clients on the local network via broadcast.

allowed_ips.description: List of IP addresses allowed to connect or be contacted. If empty, allows all or relies on auto_detect.

file_transfer.description: Enable the ability to send and receive files through the client.

recv_dir.description: Directory where received files are automatically saved.

keywords.description: List of keywords to filter incoming messages. Messages containing these words are suppressed.
